svg.title: Coverage of each simulation parameter across the 4,571 genes of the DELPHI genotype map
svg.desc: Horizontal bars. Functional annotation covers 3,857 of 4,571 genes. Items (a) to (g) of the simulation-parameter checklist cover 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 4 and 0 genes respectively; 2,972 genes have a PaxDb ppm value as a substitute for item (a). The regulatory network is reported separately because its denominator is gene pairs.

g.text: Functional annotation is nearly complete. The quantities a simulation runs on are not there.
For each of the 4,571 genes in genotype/map.vetted.json, how many have the quantity in a source fetched on 2026-10-31. Hover any mark for the query.
Checklist items (a) to (g) are per gene. Item (h), the regulatory network, is below on its own scale: its denominator is gene pairs, not genes.
Proxy species: zebrafish (Danio rerio). No flying-fish molecular data exists. No bird data: Aves is the frozen holdout.
the quantity a simulation needs, as the checklist defines it
the nearest substitute in a fetched source: wrong unit, wrong scale, or not measured
functional annotation, shown for contrast (a label, not a quantity)

rect.title: Functional annotation (GO, Reactome, KEGG): 3,857 of 4,571 genes. genotype/pathways.slim.json, built from the ZFIN GO association file, Reactome v98 (every zebrafish row inferred by orthology from human) and KEGG dre, retrieved 2026-10-31. This is the premise under test, not a simulation parameter: a pathway name is a categorical label.

line.title: (a) absolute abundance, molecules per cell: 0 of 4,571 genes. Strict: no fetched source gives any of these genes a count per cell or a calibrated concentration in a named cell type at a named stage. Substitute: PaxDb v6.1 Danio rerio, pax-db.org/downloads/latest/datasets/7955/ (35 datasets offered), retrieved 2026-10-31. Its unit is ppm, a share of total protein mass in a whole organism or a dissected organ. Expression Atlas holds 25 zebrafish experiments, all in TPM or FPKM, which the checklist excludes.

rect.title: (a) absolute abundance, molecules per cell, substitute (have a PaxDb ppm value instead): 2,972 of 4,571 genes. Strict: no fetched source gives any of these genes a count per cell or a calibrated concentration in a named cell type at a named stage. Substitute: PaxDb v6.1 Danio rerio, pax-db.org/downloads/latest/datasets/7955/ (35 datasets offered), retrieved 2026-10-31. Its unit is ppm, a share of total protein mass in a whole organism or a dissected organ. Expression Atlas holds 25 zebrafish experiments, all in TPM or FPKM, which the checklist excludes.

g.text: 2,972 have a PaxDb ppm value instead

line.title: (b) protein half-life or degradation rate: 0 of 4,571 genes. BioNumbers census (every zebrafish entry in the database, 19 of them, all result pages followed): not one is a protein half-life. PaxDb offers no zebrafish turnover dataset among its 35. Europe PMC returns 2,228 papers on the subject, so the measurement exists in prose and figures, not in a table a simulation could read.
(c) mRNA half-life: 0 of 4,571 genes. BioNumbers census: no zebrafish mRNA half-life. Europe PMC returns 820 papers. No queried database holds it per gene.
(d) transcription rate or promoter strength: 0 of 4,571 genes. BioNumbers census: no zebrafish transcription rate or promoter strength. Europe PMC returns 451 papers.

g.text: (e) Kd, or Km and kcat if an enzyme

line.title: (e) Kd, or Km and kcat if an enzyme: 0 of 4,571 genes. SABIO-RK holds 77,042 kinetic-law entries over 7,130 UniProt accessions. 5 of those accessions are zebrafish (48 entries for Danio rerio in all), and not one of the five genes behind them (adh8a, adh8b, grk1a, grk7a, ido1) is in this map. BRENDA's only open programmatic endpoint, the DSMZ SPARQL prototype, has no Km, kcat, Ki or Kd class or predicate anywhere in its 10,987,199 triples, and its website search for 'Danio rerio' returned no results. Queried 2026-10-31.

(f) diffusion coefficient, if secreted: 4 of 4,571 genes - too few to draw at this scale, shown as a tick. Four secreted molecules have a fetched coefficient: Fgf8a, Lefty2, Squint and Cyclops (sim-engine/params/zebrafish-morphogens.json, fetched 2026-10-31), every one measured in the GASTRULA, two read in a primary source and the rest quoted second-hand. The fifth, Shh in the pectoral fin bud, which is what the first validation target needs, is an explicit placeholder with no value. Counted as molecules, not genes.

(f) diffusion coefficient, if secreted, substitute (more: a placeholder with no value): 1 of 4,571 genes - too few to draw at this scale. Four secreted molecules have a fetched coefficient: Fgf8a, Lefty2, Squint and Cyclops (sim-engine/params/zebrafish-morphogens.json, fetched 2026-10-31), every one measured in the GASTRULA, two read in a primary source and the rest quoted second-hand. The fifth, Shh in the pectoral fin bud, which is what the first validation target needs, is an explicit placeholder with no value. Counted as molecules, not genes.

g.text: 1 more: a placeholder with no value

line.title: (g) Hill coefficient or cooperativity: 0 of 4,571 genes. SABIO-RK does carry 'Hill coefficient' among its 39 parameter types, so the gap is zebrafish coverage, not schema. BioNumbers census: no zebrafish Hill coefficient. Europe PMC returns 507 papers.

g.text: (h) the regulatory network, on its own scale: 10,444,735 unordered pairs among the 4,571 genes

g.title: STRING v12 zebrafish, experiments channel only (transferred evidence excluded), union with IntAct curated pairs between two of these genes (80). Undirected and unsigned, with a confidence score rather than a strength. Across the WHOLE zebrafish proteome STRING holds only 3,873 such edges, touching 612 proteins, against 4,070,667 edges whose experimental evidence is transferred from another species. Retrieved 2026-10-31.
genotype/causal-chains.json cross_gene: epistasis and pathway-order statements, each with a verbatim quote from a fetched paper. None carries a rate constant.
No fetched source gives a strength, weight or rate constant for any edge between two of these genes.

OmniPath serves taxa 9606;10090;10116 and refuses 7955, so CollecTRI's 64,516 human signed TF-target edges can reach these genes only through ZFIN orthology, most of it protein BLAST. A hypothesis list, not zebrafish data, and one human edge can map to several zebrafish pairs. Retrieved 2026-10-31.

g.text: Headline: 0 of the 18,733 numbers a minimal model needs are held - 4 per gene for (a) to (d), plus one strength per edge of the 449-edge list.
Relaxing item (a) to accept a PaxDb ppm value raises that to 2,972 of 18,733, or 15.9%. Every query is logged in simulation-readiness/calls.json.
